business_summary: Nippon Information Development Co., Ltd. offers information technology solutions in Japan and internationally. It offers mobile solutions, including Android and iOS native applications, and preinstalled applications; a range of technologies for home electronics and IoT, such as cloud-cooperation televisions and game machines; and configurations for terminal applications and various cloud servers. The company also provides a range of embedded technologies comprising ECU development as vehicle infrastructure and automated driving systems of automobiles; medical system technologies for the production of therapeutic and diagnostic apparatus, as well as for the development of hospital information systems; social infrastructure for public wireless domains consisting of airports, trains, fire, and disaster prevention; various technologies for factory and plant control systems; and real-time OS, image processing, communication protocol, and various drivers and middleware systems. In addition, it offers contract and customer management systems for individual and group insurances; non-life insurance systems; mutual aid systems; credit systems; and securities systems. Further, the company provides payroll and benefit systems for civil service; web-based itinerary information validation systems; and logistics systems; and system construction and installation support, network server design/construction, server virtualization environment creation, and cloud migration support services. Additionally, it offers system/network operation maintenance; remote surveillance; IT system operational design improvement; security operational management services; business process outsourcing; and data image entry services, as well as glass live connect, a concierge service solution for online and local stores using SmartGlass; MIEL, a guidance support software for insurance; and Midori Online Accounting System. The company was incorporated in 1967 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.
